entry_sequence.action: when the stock actually breaks above the v-wop after being below it at the opening bell i'm looking to buy on those pull backs looking for the v-wap to hold it up as support

i'm using that vwop level as that big milestone level and then i'm buying on the pullbacks to test as a support area ... looking to dip by into pull backs to the v-wop in anticipating a bounce at the v-wop level
we can buy the pullback into that first few bounces you can see the momentum coming in after that pullback was really really nice

confluences.description: they see the volume come in ... a ton of green candles in a row which obviously shows a lot of strength
if i can find a stock that opens weak on the day and actually drops at the opening bell below the v-wop and then breaks above it with some volume coming in that's my favorite area to dip buy into
waiting for pullbacks after big runs like that especially to the v-wop or a whole dollar level
